Package common.core.swerve

package common.core.swerve
The team's own swerve drive code, from before 2025.

Robots now use CTRE's generated swerve code instead (CommandSwerveDrivetrain in the robot project), which runs odometry faster and is kept up to date by CTRE. This package is still here for older robots, and as an example of how swerve works:

  • SwerveModule: one wheel, with a motor that drives it, a motor that steers it, and a CANcoder that knows which way it points.
  • SwerveBase: four modules working together, plus a pose estimator that tracks where the robot is.
  • CTREModuleState and SwerveConversions: the math in between.
